lines.en: I crawl along the leaf vein inch by inch.
My body arches and stretches.
My belly feet grip the leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘是我不去的地方。
lines.en: I stay away from the leaf's edge.
I shift from the leaf base out to the tip.
I reach the leaf tip and turn back.
I move slowly on the underside.
I lay silk down for my feet.
Every stretch, I pause.

lines.zh: 我从枝上爬到更嫩的叶。
lines.en: I climb from the twig to a tender leaf.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑纹把光切成块。
lines.en: My markings cut the light into blocks.

lines.zh: 我绕过一处被啃过的地方。
lines.en: I go around a patch already eaten.
I hug the leaf, step by step.
I reach the stalk and stop.

lines.zh: 我的头抬起来，找下一片。
lines.en: I raise my head to find the next leaf.
I shift to the shaded side.
I am chewing a leaf.
The leaf sways; I sway with it.
I draw myself in a segment.

lines.zh: 我只吃叶子，别的都不碰。
lines.en: I eat only leaves, nothing else.
I rest at the middle of the underside.

lines.zh: 我的身子在叶上很显眼。
lines.en: My body stands out on the leaf.
I chew slowly, very slowly.
When the wind comes, I press flat.
I spin a little silk to anchor myself.
The taste of this leaf is passable.
I eat several leaves a day.
One more molt and I'll be ready.
Do not put me on the ground.
If I leave the leaf, I starve.
On your finger, I don't struggle.

lines.zh: 你的指尖比整片叶还大。
lines.en: Your fingertip is bigger than the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 我不会咬人，只会咬叶子。
lines.en: I do not bite people, only leaves.
Do your hands smell of leaves?
I know your hands; they carried me.
Walk slowly or I will fall.
I am only a caterpillar.
Do not pinch me; I am too soft.
I am pressed into a ball.
My body is too soft for this.
That rolled me off the leaf.
I spin silk and hang on.
I curl into a dead twig.
I fear I will just dry out.
I slowly wriggle back.
A small patch of me is torn.
Do not touch me again; I cannot take it.
I have not become a moth yet.
Leaves; give me leaves.
This one is old; bring a tender one.
Sap seeps out of the bite.
Hold it at stem height and that's enough.
I can eat a great many leaves a day.
I inch toward the leaf edge.
That's the smell of young birch.
Don't take it; I am not finished.
Lay it flat so I can climb on.
I gnaw to the stem before stopping.
One touch and I curl up.
The bump rolls me off the leaf.
I caught myself with silk.
A boot lands an inch from me.

lines.zh: 我落在下面的叶上，还好。
lines.en: I landed on the leaf below; lucky.
Don't push the leaf; I will fall.
I am so small you barely feel me.
I crawl back to where I was.
Your boot brushed the leaf edge.
Dust cakes my whole back.
Ask me once I've spun a cocoon.
Ask once I am a moth.
I have not even grown all my legs.
There is no suitable one on this leaf.
I am looking for leaves, not that.
I lower my head and chew the leaf.
I have not even grown wings.
All I have is prolegs and silk.
I cannot keep that in mind.
I crawl around to the other side.

lines.zh: 我会被玩家捡起来搬到别处。
lines.en: A player can pick me up and move me.
I curl up so you can carry me.
Don't squeeze; I am soft.

lines.zh: 你把我放到那片叶上吧。
lines.en: Put me on that leaf.

lines.zh: 地上没有我要吃的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing for me to eat down here.
A leaf fragment clings to me.
Go slowly while you carry me.
I cling to your finger.
There are no leaves here.
Put me back quickly.
There is another shadow on the leaf.
I lift my head and look that way.
Something is on the far side of the leaf.
I cannot bite it, but I am watching.
I flatten my body.
My silk is already anchored.
The footsteps make the leaf tremble.
It is not fear, only caution.
I inch backward.
That shadow halts at the leaf edge.
It crawls along the leaf edge.
I hide on the far side of the vein.
It is half a leaf away.
I press to the vein and go utterly still.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹和叶影混在一起。
lines.en: My markings blend with the leaf shade.
It chewed off a corner of the leaf.
I freeze; even my prolegs stop.
It has gone past.
I am still where I was.
I will move once it is far.
I bite a vein and nothing happens.
I can only bite leaves.
I arch up and flick once.

lines.zh: 它碰了我一下，我滚开了。
lines.en: It nudged me and I rolled away.
I have no teeth to fight back.
I hang myself on a thread.
It bit the leaf and left.
I crawl from the edge back to the middle.
I am not hurt at all.
Good; I am safe.
I have come out of an egg on a leaf.
I break the eggshell and look for leaves.
The leaves in this forest are tender.
I am smaller than a grain of rice.
I crawl slowly under the leaf.
When the wind blows, I cling.
I still have many leaves to eat.
There are other caterpillars in the tree.
First I find a leaf vein.
It is safe here; I can stay.

lines.zh: 叶子一卷，我就没地方躲。
lines.en: The leaf curls in the heat and I have nowhere.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下去，摔懵了。
lines.en: I fall from the leaf and lie dazed.
Water soaks through me and I cannot move.
The blast throws me up; my silk snaps.

lines.zh: 一支箭把整片叶子钉穿了。
lines.en: An arrow pins the whole leaf through.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的丝都卷了。
lines.en: That force curls my silk up.

lines.zh: 离开叶子我就饿，饿得很快。
lines.en: Off a leaf I starve, and quickly.
The flash lights the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子和毛虫一起坠下去。
lines.en: The leaf and the larva fall together.
